messages.subject: RE: Project Lyra – MSSA mark-up (Verdant response v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Attached is Verdant's response mark-up (v3, tracked against your v2). To summarise where we've landed:

• Availability: accepted at 99.7%.
• Service credits: back to 10% cap, with a softened 'sole remedy' that preserves Pennland's right to terminate for material breach.
• RPI uplift: capped at 4% p.a.
• Liability: 125% of trailing 12-months' Charges, with a £1,000,000 super-cap (not uncapped) for data-protection breaches.

We think this is a fair landing zone. Call me if helpful.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
